articles.title: US military aircraft leave second UK base
articles.description: The departures come weeks after the US withdrew bombers from RAF Fairford airbase over a suspected Iran-linked security incident.

articles.title: Met Police investigate several new reports on Russell Brand following his conviction
articles.description: Det Supt Andy Furphy says the force had received "several reports in during the trial and since the trial".

articles.title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England
articles.description: The government says it is strengthening its guidance for schools in England, which came into force in June.

articles.title: Edinburgh Academy pupils suffered decades of 'dreadful abuse'
articles.description: A report from the Scottish Child Abuse Inquiry says the school focused on protecting its reputation and ignored complaints.
